title: Technical Architect, Java, Microservices
description:
Position Title Technical Architect Java & Microservices 
 Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Technical Architect with strong expertise in Java, Microservices Architecture, and Cloud-Native Technologies to lead the design and delivery of scalable, secure, and high-performance enterprise applications. The ideal candidate will provide technical leadership, define architecture standards, guide development teams, and drive best practices across the software development lifecycle. 
 Key Responsibilities Define and drive application architecture, technical standards, and solution designs for enterprise platforms. Design scalable, resilient, and secure microservices-based applications using Java technologies. Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Lead architecture reviews, design discussions, and technology evaluations. Establish best practices for application development, integration, performance optimization, and system reliability. Design and implement API-driven architectures, including RESTful and event-driven services. Provide technical leadership and mentorship to development teams. Drive modernization initiatives, including migration from monolithic to microservices architectures. Ensure adherence to security, governance, compliance, and coding standards. Collaborate with DevOps teams to establish CI/CD pipelines and cloud deployment strategies. Review code, identify technical risks, and recommend mitigation strategies. Support troubleshooting of complex production issues and perform root cause analysis. Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend innovations aligned with business goals. 
 Required Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 10+ years of software development experience with a strong focus on Java technologies. 3+ years of experience in Solution Architecture or Technical Architecture roles. Strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Spring Framework, and Microservices Architecture. Experience designing and developing REST APIs and distributed systems. Strong knowledge of design patterns, object-oriented design, and software engineering principles. Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. Hands-on experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and orchestration platforms like Kubernetes/OpenShift. Familiarity with messaging systems such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or ActiveMQ. Experience with relational and NoSQL databases. Understanding of DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code concepts. Strong knowledge of application security, authentication, and authorization frameworks. 
 Preferred Qualifications Experience with Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and Event-Driven Architecture. Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP). Experience in large-scale enterprise digital transformation programs. Knowledge of serverless and cloud-native architectures. Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. TOGAF or other architecture certifications are a plus. 
 Technical Skills Core Technologies Java 8/11/17+ Spring Boot Spring Cloud Hibernate/JPA RESTful APIs Microservices Cloud & DevOps AWS / Azure / GCP Docker Kubernetes / OpenShift Jenkins GitHub Actions / GitLab CI/CD Terraform Messaging & Integration Apache Kafka RabbitMQ API Gateway Service Mesh Databases Oracle PostgreSQL MySQL MongoDB Cassandra Monitoring & Observability Grafana Prometheus ELK Stack Splunk Dynatrace

Key Skills: Technical Architect,Java,Microservices,Technical architecture,Architecture,Technical
